notes: Major release: multi-customer / multi-account support. The tool previously supported exactly one Active IQ credential at a time (a single refreshToken in aiq_config.json, a singleton SQLite cache row). It now supports any number of separate Active IQ accounts -- different customers, different logins -- synced independently and merged into one unified cross-customer fleet view, matching the tool's existing 'all customers in one pane' design intent but extended to customers reachable only via separate credentials rather than sub-accounts of one login. Backward compatible: existing single-token configs are auto-migrated (both the config shape and the cached harvest data) with zero action required and zero behavior change if you never add a second account. New: a 'Multiple Customer Accounts' card in Settings & Config to add/label/enable/disable/remove accounts (tokens never round-trip to the browser -- the UI only ever sees hasToken:true/false). New server internals: per-account harvest tagging (accountId/accountLabel on every system/cluster/risk/case), a sequential multi-account sync orchestrator (deliberately not parallel, to stay polite to NetApp's API and avoid one bad token blocking others), a read-time merge layer with dedup, and an optional ?account=<id> scope on /api/harvest for single-account views. Removing an account from Settings now correctly drops it from the merged view instead of leaving an orphaned cache entry behind forever. Extensively live-tested end-to-end, including simulating a genuine 3-account merge (501 systems across 3 tagged accounts, correctly deduplicated and aggregated) before being reverted to the real single-account config.
